definitions.explanation: A brewery that makes sake (also soy sauce or miso), or the family or person who owns and runs it.

examples.japanese: {蔵元|くらもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蔵元|くらもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{造|つく}っている→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This sake is made by a long-established brewery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{蔵元|くらもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{杜氏|とうじ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泊|と}まり{込|こ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{酒造|さけづく}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: In winter, the master brewers live in at the brewery and work on making sake.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The {蔵元|くらもと} owns the brewery; the {杜氏|とうじ} is the master brewer who directs the work. Many small breweries are family businesses going back centuries, and a brewery tour with tasting ({蔵元|くらもと}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧) is a popular outing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蔵元|くらもと}: a sake brewery
- {蔵元|くらもと}⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧: shipped directly from the brewery
- {蔵元|くらもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: to visit a brewery

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{酒蔵|さかぐら}→酒蔵：08633_sakagura⟧: sake brewery (the building)
- ⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧: sake
- {杜氏|とうじ}: master brewer
